package.name: threevn_dashboard
package.description:
Live web dashboard and health endpoints for the 3VN arm.
Aggregates robot state from ROS and serves it over plain HTTP: a snapshot, a Server-Sent Events stream, health and readiness probes, and the deployment version block.
Uses Server-Sent Events rather than a WebSocket. A dashboard only needs one direction, SSE is ordinary HTTP so it proxies without special configuration, and it satisfies the shared Caddy's `connect-src 'self'` policy when served under the same origin - which means no product-wide CSP change is needed.
ARCHITECTURAL RULE: like threevn_bringup and threevn_control, this package must never depend on Gazebo. It reads the same ROS interface whether the robot is mock, simulated or physical.
